Construct a Diplomacy order

Source: R/order.R
dp_order.Rd

Builds a single order as a one-row dp_orders tibble. Orders are combined with rbind() or dp_bind_orders(), and rendered back to standard notation by format().

Usage

dp_order(
  power,
  type,
  unit = NULL,
  target = NULL,
  aux = NULL,
  unit_type = NULL,
  aux_type = NULL,
  via_convoy = FALSE,
  map = dp_map(),
  call = rlang::caller_env()
)

Arguments

power

Ordering power, for example "France".

type

One of "hold", "move", "support", "convoy", "retreat", "build", "disband" or "waive".

unit

Location of the ordered unit, for example "par" or "spa/nc". Ignored for "waive".

target

Destination province for moves, retreats and builds, or NULL.

aux

For supports and convoys, the order being supported or convoyed: either a single province (a unit ordered to hold) or a length-2 vector c(from, to), or the string "from-to".

unit_type

"army" or "fleet". Required for builds; otherwise inferred from map when possible.

aux_type

"army" or "fleet" for the supported or convoyed unit.

via_convoy

Force a move to be routed by convoy. Default FALSE.

map

A dp_map object used to validate locations.

call

Caller environment, for error reporting. Experts only.

Value

A one-row dp_orders tibble with columns power, type, unit_type, loc, target, aux_type, aux_loc, aux_target and via_convoy.

See also

Other orders: as_tibble.dp_orders(), dp_bind_orders(), dp_example_orders(), dp_legal_orders(), dp_orders, dp_parse_orders(), format.dp_orders(), is_dp_orders()

Examples

dp_order("France", "move", "par", target = "bur")
#> <dp_orders> (1 order)
#> France: A Par - Bur
dp_order("England", "support", "lon", aux = c("wal", "yor"))
#> <dp_orders> (1 order)
#> England: Lon S Wal - Yor
dp_order("England", "convoy", "nth", aux = "lon-nwy")
#> <dp_orders> (1 order)
#> England: F Nth C Lon - Nwy
